entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem who created the artificial world Argentum, later called Mirrodin, and unwittingly infected it with Phyrexian corruption.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The artificial metal world created by Karn, slowly consumed by Phyrexia, with a hollow core.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The oil-blooded civilization growing within Mirrodin since its beginning, at war with the Mirrans.

entities.name: Mirrans
entities.description: The peoples of Mirrodin who fight Phyrexia using darksteel.

entities.name: darksteel
entities.description: An indestructible, magical dark metal found on Mirrodin, shaped only by powerful artificers.

entities.name: Vault of Whispers
entities.description: A vault vampires hope to take from Geth.

entities.name: Geth
entities.description: Holder of the Vault of Whispers, whom vampires hope to supplant.

entities.name: Bleak Coven
entities.description: Vampire warriors and assassins from Rey-Goor who work as mercenaries, taking the bodies and souls of rivals as payment.

entities.name: Nim Onslaught
entities.description: An event after which more vampires were spawned and their nature changed.

entities.name: Moriok
entities.description: A people who increasingly chose to become vampires rather than nim.

entities.name: Rey-Goor
entities.description: Area where the Mephidross Swamp has spread into the periphery of the Tangle Forest.

events.summary: Karn creates Argentum, later Mirrodin, and a drop of Phyrexian oil within him infects the world.
events.quote: A single drop of the oil was all it took.

events.summary: After the Nim Onslaught, Moriok increasingly chose to become vampires, and vampire communities contest territory around the Vault of Whispers.
events.quote: Moriok increasingly chose the latter, and now entire communities of vampires exist

events.summary: The Mirrans fight Phyrexia and turn to darksteel to aid them.
events.quote: they've turned to darksteel to aid in their fight

relations.quote: the silver golem Karn created the artificial world Argentum, later called the plane of Mirrodin
the Mirrans fight that civilization of oil-blooded necro-monstrosities that share their plane
the Bleak Coven vampires are from Rey-Goor
